lines.zh: 我一步踩下，黑曜石在响。
lines.en: One step of mine and the obsidian rings.
My shadow is longer than the spire.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走到台边，往下看。
lines.en: I walk slowly to the platform edge and look down.

lines.zh: 我身上的光随着步子一明一暗。
lines.en: The light on me pulses with each step.
I circle along the spire's rim.
My claws bite into the stone.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下裂痕。
lines.en: Cracks follow me.

lines.zh: 我转过身，塔顶都跟着抖。
lines.en: I turn, and the spire top shakes.

lines.zh: 我的脚落下去，石台发闷。
lines.en: My feet fall and the stone ledge groans.
I walk to the other side of the spire.

lines.zh: 我站着，胸口的光一开一合。
lines.en: I stand, the light in my chest opening and closing.
My heart shows through my chest.
Endermites move around me.
I look down at the world below.
The wind can't get around me.
I turn my palm over and look at it.
This spire is mine.
I'm in no hurry; I'll wait for you to climb.
My breathing weighs the air down.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看着石台。
lines.en: I lower my head and look at the platform.
The wound in my chest is always there.
I roll a wrist.
I'm counting the steps of the spire.
The obsidian here is cold.
I'll give you nothing.
I set my hand on the spire's edge.
You climbed up here — not easy.

lines.zh: 你站在我掌心那么大的石台上。
lines.en: You stand on a ledge the size of my palm.
You've seen my chest.
And you can't reach it yet.
And you can't reach it yet.
I lift a hand, straight at you.
There's only obsidian under your feet.
You shouldn't have come up.

lines.zh: 我把另一只手也抬起来。
lines.en: I raise the other hand too.
You gave half a step — wise.
I look down and my light falls on you.
You've come all this way for nothing.
One step back and the spire rings.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我胸口旁边。
lines.en: The blow landed beside my heart.
I've gone down on one knee.

lines.zh: 胸口的伤被碰到了，很疼。
lines.en: The wound in my chest is struck, and it hurts.
I brace a hand on the spire.
My breathing is deep and slow.
A corner of my light goes dark.
I press my chest and push up on one knee.
I look down at you from my lowered head.
I'll remember that one; it hurt.

lines.zh: 这世上没有我要吃的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing in this world I eat.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我连头都没低。
lines.en: You hold it up and I don't even lower my head.
I brush a hand and it's gone.

lines.zh: 这点东西也想换我的塔。
lines.en: You'd trade that for my spire.
I have no hunger in me.

lines.zh: 你把它放在台边，我不管。
lines.en: You leave it on the edge; I ignore it.
I kick it off the platform.
Keep it; you need it more.
All I want is you down below.

lines.zh: 我的眼只盯着塔下的你。
lines.en: My eyes stay on you at the tower's foot.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我一点没动。
lines.en: You hit my leg and I don't move at all.

lines.zh: 这一下让塔顶颤了一下。
lines.en: The knock makes the spire top tremble.

lines.zh: 我抬脚让开，你别掉下去。
lines.en: I lift a foot clear so you don't fall.

lines.zh: 我的甲把你的刀弹开了。
lines.en: My armor throws your blade off.
The shock slides you half a foot.
It's hard to stay upright on obsidian.
I look down as you grip the edge.
I put a hand out and steady you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，石头掉了一块。
lines.en: We collide and a piece of stone falls.
I simply stand there without shifting.

lines.zh: 她也是这个样子，只是更老。
lines.en: She's made the same, only older.
Less of her heart shows than mine.
We regard each other across the platform.

lines.zh: 末影傀儡在我们脚边停住。
lines.en: The endermites stop at our feet.
We touch foreheads.

lines.zh: 声音在这上面传得很远。
lines.en: Sound carries far up here.

lines.zh: 她转过身，看向下面的世界。
lines.en: She turns to look at the world below.

lines.zh: 我们也曾经是一个样子。
lines.en: We were the same once.
The spire is still ringing as she leaves.

lines.zh: 这座塔可以两个人守着。
lines.en: Two can keep this spire.
I bend and pinch it up.
It's a pebble in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它捏在拇指和食指间。
lines.en: I hold it between thumb and forefinger.
I don't need this.
I let go and it falls away.
I crush it in my palm.

lines.zh: 它在我指间没有一点重量。
lines.en: It has no weight between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它按进黑曜石的裂口。
lines.en: I press it into a crack in the obsidian.

lines.zh: 这上面还留着你的汗味。
lines.en: Your sweat still clings to it.
I keep it for when you come again.
Your steps stop at the ledge.
I face you squarely, my chest glowing.
My chest lights up.
That rock won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我向前迈了一步，塔在响。
lines.en: I take one step forward and the tower rings.

lines.zh: 你脚下已经没有退的地方。
lines.en: There's nowhere left behind you.
Once I have you, that's enough.
I don't need to strike.
I open both hands.
One more step and you're gone.
I have you locked down.

lines.zh: 你的重量在我手里不算什么。
lines.en: Your weight means nothing to me.
The wind won't help you up here.
I watch you without moving.
I slowly press you toward the tower's edge.
You run a circle at the platform's edge.
I scoop and you slip aside.
This side drops away into nothing.
I herd you toward it.
You grip the edge of the stone.
I bend and reach.
Don't be afraid; it'll be quick.
You kick; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的肋骨。
lines.en: My fingers close around your ribs.
You struggle in my hands.
I lift you slowly.
The wind from below starts to rise.
I move to the spire's edge.
Then I let go.
You're looking at me as you fall.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩下去，石头崩了。
lines.en: I bring a foot down and stone bursts.
One palm and the platform cracks.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂往上一带。
lines.en: I catch your arm and haul you up.
Darkness starts to spread over you.
I lift you overhead.
You're a sheaf of grass in my hands.
Two steps take me to the edge.
Then my hand opens.
You catch the spire's rim.

lines.zh: 我俯身让眼睛与你齐平。
lines.en: I stoop until my eyes are level with yours.
I take another step down.
Rubble falls off the platform.

lines.zh: 我捏紧拳头，又举了起来。
lines.en: I clench my fist and raise it again.

lines.zh: 你胸口的动静我全听见了。
lines.en: I hear everything stirring in your chest.
I rise on the spire's top.
The obsidian rings under my feet.
The wound in my chest lights first.

lines.zh: 末影傀儡在四周聚过来。
lines.en: Endermites gather around me.
Everything above here is mine.
I raise my head from the spire's top.
The air settles heavy.
I try closing my hands.
The world below looks pitifully small.
I hear someone on the steps.

lines.zh: 我挪到石台的边上站住。
lines.en: I move to the platform's edge.
I stand there and wait.

lines.zh: 塔顶的风把我身上的光吹动。
lines.en: Wind on the spire stirs my light.
I need no weapon at all.
I raise a hand and light gathers in my palm.
Come up; I'm right here.
The echo on the steps is long.

lines.zh: 这一回没人骗得过我了。
lines.en: No disguise will fool me now.
I set both hands at my sides.
The stone under me is solid.

lines.zh: 火燎上来，被我的外壳挡住一半。
lines.en: Fire climbs me and my shell stops half of it.

lines.zh: 我从塔上摔下去，很长的距离。
lines.en: I fall from the spire — a long way.

lines.zh: 水从下面涌上来，我挣不脱。
lines.en: Water surges up and I can't break free.

lines.zh: 爆炸震开了我胸前的一片。
lines.en: The blast opens a plate at my chest.

lines.zh: 一根长矛扎进我的胸甲边。
lines.en: A spear lodges at the edge of my chest plate.
Spell-light works into the wound in my chest.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会衰弱。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I can still weaken.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，胸口的伤更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my chest wound flares.

lines.zh: 下面全是空，我一直在落。
lines.en: All empty below, and I keep falling.
